pins.title: Can you sing a line backwards?
pins.description: Say an original challenge line, hear it backwards, copy the sound, then see how close your copy gets. A reverse-singing party game concept coming soon to iPhone.

pins.title: A party game for up to 8
pins.description: Pass the phone around and take turns with a reverse-singing challenge. Party mode supports up to eight players. Coming soon to iPhone.

pins.title: Make game night delightfully weird
pins.description: Try original challenge lines like “Boing, my toast!” Hear each one backwards, copy the sound, and laugh at the result.

pins.title: Daily reverse-singing challenge
pins.description: Take on a daily challenge and build a streak. A playful new party-game concept in the works for iPhone.

pins.title: 10 free goes, then an optional unlock
pins.description: Try 10 scored rounds before deciding whether to unlock more. Plus is a one-time purchase; no ads or subscription. Coming soon to iPhone.

reddit.question: What’s a fun app for a small group game night?
reddit.reply: A reverse-singing party game could be fun: players copy a line played backwards, then compare their attempts. One in development supports up to eight players.

reddit.question: Any family-friendly games that get everyone laughing?
reddit.reply: Try a word or sound challenge that’s easy to take turns with. There’s a reverse-singing game in development using original lines like “Boing, my toast!”

reddit.question: Is there a reverse-singing game with scoring?
reddit.reply: One upcoming iPhone game idea scores how closely your copy matches the original, with a party mode and daily challenges. It’s still pre-launch.
